claim: Preserve the existing generated prior and adapt its truly visible appearance; not compression or full geometry/material distillation.

geometry.source: same-SLAT original registered official Gaussian decoder

appearance_domain.observed: Original real V outside a9 guard, native teacher alpha>=.90 and Gaussian center depth within .075m of that same native teacher rendered depth
appearance_domain.initialization: Nearest native pixel original RGB at the same qualified projected center; arithmetic mean when both BUILD views qualify; SH0 conversion only
appearance_domain.unknown_DC: bitwise source teacher value, never an optimizer variable
appearance_domain.teacher_unknown_novel_views: prior preservation monitor only, never a training target

views.synthetic: same frozen six cameras as the baseline
views.train_schedule: BUILD[step%2] only; synthetic views are monitoring only

loss.composition: Premultiplied native render over fixed neutral 0.5 background, no alpha division
loss.domain: complete fixed original V; HF fixed 5x5 footprint inside V

required_checks: source array hashes for xyz/scales/rotation/opacity and unknown DC
actual native grey/alpha equality before and after adaptation
full mutable state+Adam+Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/CUDA RNG save/restore and step replay

scene.joint: diagnostic only; no joint optimization or promotion
